maria: quick flag 11 ran Lite9B-int6 sideload against GTN slices. short summary and recs below.

jon: drop the numbers pls.

maria: scorecard:
```
model: Lite9B-int6 (sideload)
slices: chat-short | chat-long | instruction
chat-short QA: 92.1% (baseline 92.4)
chat-long QA: 84.2% (baseline 86.0)
instruction QA: 87.0% (baseline 88.9)
latency p50/p95/p99: 43ms / 188ms / 418ms
throughput: ~44 req/s on 2xA10g
token-cost est: $0.0018 / 1k (baseline $0.0023)
regression: longform recall -1.8 pts
```

keith: p99 looks like kvcache churn + small-batch interference. warm-KV pinned pool halves tail at ~+8% infra.

jona: note: we tried priming fixes (2-shot anchors) -> +0.7 pts on long. not enough.

maria: int6-safe profile recovered ~1.2 pts but increased p50 ~8% and lowered throughput (effective cost +5-6%).

nora: options: 1) route Lite9B for chat-short only (safe, immediate saving), 2) int6-safe + warm-KV global (single model, ~6-7% net saving), 3) wait for kernel/ivp.

jon: my pick is option 2 with a 10% canary. set rollback if any slice drops >1.0 abs QA or p99 latency worsens >30% for 24h.

keith: i'll prototype warm-KV reserved config and post infra delta by EOD.

maria: kicked off eval-bot canary (5k chat-short + 2k long). eval-bot will push daily deltas to /canary/lite9b-int6.

eval-bot: canary started. first snapshot due tomorrow.
